name: Wheat
why: Staple cereal; dwarf wheat completed seed-to-seed life cycles on the Mir space station greenhouse

name: Potato
why: High-yield tuber staple; grown in a Mars-conditions simulator by the International Potato Center

name: Soybean
why: Plant protein and oil crop: the main staple source of protein where no livestock is kept

name: Leafy greens (lettuce)
why: Fresh vegetables grown on the ISS in the Veggie growth system

name: Single-cell protein (methanotroph biomass)
why: Protein-rich bacterial biomass grown on methane and ammonia in a fermenter, so Sabatier methane can feed a crew with no farmland

name: Food ration (dry, packaged)
why: What a crew actually eats: dried, packaged food, about 1 kg dry mass per person per day on beyond-LEO missions
